dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Hmmm... I promised Collei some rich mushroom soup tonight. Other than mushrooms, I still need to buy a few seasonings...

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Cyno, what are you looking at? Interested in trying this 'shroom variety?

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: No, but I am pondering a related question.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Cyno, is he myco-managing the shopping?

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: #It's you, {NICKNAME}. That joke wasn't bad. Allow me to soak it in.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: #Huh? What did {M#he}{F#she} say just now? Micro... Myco...

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Please, you two, that's enough. It's almost time to eat.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, care to join us? Collei would be delighted if you were there.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: Hmm, not bad. Still, it's a pity. I haven't found any nyuzshrooms yet.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: "Nyuzshroom"? Now that's one I've never heard. Is it some newly-discovered species?

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: That can't be it. I keep track of every project related to cultivating new species, but I've never heard that name.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: Exactly. After all, the "newsrooms" have yet to make the press release.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Cyno. You're finishing every last drop of this soup tonight. Got that?

choices.text: I was taught by the best.
